description: Configure the existing survey 'Global Tech Summit 2024' for public attendee self-registration. Log in to the LimeSurvey admin panel (admin/Admin123!). Enable public registration with CAPTCHA protection to prevent bots. Then, customize the participant registration form by adding two new mandatory attributes: 'Organization' and 'Job Title'. Ensure both of these fields are visible on the public registration page so attendees must fill them out to receive their entry token.
